fields.title: Excel format
fields.description: Select the Excel file format to write.

fields.title: If exists
fields.description:
Specify the behavior of the node in case the output file already exists.
  • Fail: Will issue an error during the node's execution (to prevent unintentional overwrite).
  • Overwrite: Will replace any existing file.
  • Ignore: Will ignore if a file already exists and continues the copying process.

fields.title: Create missing folders
fields.description: If enabled, missing folders in the specified path will be created automatically.

fields.title: Password to protect files
fields.description: If enabled, the output file will be password-protected. This supports XLS files (using weak encryption) and XLSX files (using AES encryption).

fields.title: Password to protect files
fields.description: Allows you to specify a password to protect the output file with. In case the "append" option is selected and the file already exists, the password must be valid for the existing file.

fields.title: Workflow credentials
fields.description: Select the workflow credentials to use.

fields.title: Password
fields.description: Enter the password to protect the file.

fields.title: If sheet exists
fields.description: Specify the behavior of the node in case a sheet with the entered name already exists. (This option is only relevant if the file append option is selected.)

fields.title: Merge data with identical sheet names into one sheet
fields.description: If checked, it is possible to provide the same sheet name for multiple input tables. Data from those tables will be concatenated into the same sheet in the order the tables are connected.

fields.title: Write row key
fields.description: If checked, the row IDs are added to the output, in the first column of the spreadsheet.

fields.title: Write column headers
fields.description: If checked, the column names are written out in the first row of the spreadsheet.

fields.title: Don't write column headers if sheet exists
fields.description: Only write the column headers if a sheet is newly created or replaced. This option is convenient if you have written data with the same specification to an existing sheet before and want to append new rows to it.

fields.title: Replace missing values
fields.description: If selected, missing values will be replaced by the specified value, otherwise a blank cell is being created.

fields.title: Evaluate formulas (leave unchecked if uncertain, see help for details)
fields.description: If checked, all formulas in the file will be evaluated after the sheet has been written. This is useful if other sheets in the file refer to the data just written and their content needs updating. This option is only relevant if the append option is selected. This can cause errors when there are functions that are not implemented by the underlying Apache POI library. Note: For xlsx files, evaluation requires significantly more memory as the whole file needs to be kept in memory (xls files are anyway loaded completely into memory).

fields.title: Autosize columns
fields.description: Fits each column's width to its content.

fields.title: Page orientation
fields.description: Sets the print format to portrait or landscape.

fields.title: Paper size
fields.description: Sets the paper size in the print setup.

fields.title: Open file after execution
fields.description: If enabled, the output file will be opened in the associated application after the node has successfully executed.
